en.headline: Three charities hold regional flag days across Hong Kong this morning
en.dek: The Social Welfare Department said Alzheimer's Disease Association, Guide Dogs Association and Society for Abandoned Animals will sell flags until 12.30pm.
body: The Social Welfare Department said three charities were issued public subscription permits to hold regional flag sales from 7am to 12.30pm today.

On Hong Kong Island, the Hong Kong Alzheimer's Disease Association is collecting with yellow bags and blue flags. In Kowloon, the Hong Kong Guide Dogs Association Limited is using red bags and pink flags. In the New Territories, the Society for Abandoned Animals Limited is using orange bags and blue flags.

The department said arrangements were made to help people distinguish the three separate activities. Details of the permits and contact methods are available on government websites. Anyone who suspects fraudulent flag selling should report it to police without making a donation.

zh.headline: 三間慈善機構今早分區賣旗籌款至中午
zh.dek: 社會福利署表示，香港認知障礙症協會、香港導盲犬協會及保護遺棄動物協會將於上午七時至中午十二時半賣旗。
body: 社會福利署表示，三間慈善機構已獲發公開籌款許可證，於今日上午七時至中午十二時半舉行分區賣旗活動。
港島區由香港認知障礙症協會負責，使用黃色籌款袋及藍色旗幟；九龍區由香港導盲犬協會有限公司負責，使用紅色籌款袋及粉紅色旗幟；新界區由保護遺棄動物協會有限公司負責，使用橙色籌款袋及藍色旗幟。
署方已安排協助市民分辯三項活動。許可證詳情及聯絡方法已上載政府網站。如懷疑有詐騙賣旗活動，市民不應捐款並立即向警方舉報。
